previous_experiences: Principal Software Engineer at LiveWire (Harley-Davidson EV subsidiary), leading connectivity and charging software for electric motorcycles since 2019.
Led on-board charger software team at LiveWire/HD, delivering OTA updates, data logging, and security features.
Senior Embedded Software Developer at Aeris Communications — core lead on embedded Linux-based IoT client with multi-thread, multi-process client-server design.
Led firmware design for embedded controllers and Bluetooth applications at Earlens Corporation, including OTA/wired update architecture.
Software integration on Linux and QNX platforms for infotainment and Bluetooth at Volkswagen Group of America.
Designed and applied audio amplifiers, Bluetooth products, infotainment systems, and instrument clusters at Visteon.
Earlier automotive embedded experience at General Motors, Chrysler, and Fisker Automotive.
bio_text: Mufaddal Esmael is a Principal Software Engineer specializing in embedded systems, connectivity, and charging software for electric vehicles, most recently at LiveWire (a Harley-Davidson subsidiary). He brings deep expertise spanning embedded Linux, Bluetooth, OTA update architecture, and automotive-grade software delivery across a career that includes Aeris Communications, Earlens, Volkswagen, Visteon, and legacy automotive OEMs. He is based in the Greater St. Louis / Mountain View area and is self-described as currently independent.
